messages:
ops-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: serving-prod us-west-2 - spike in throttle events and queue depth. 429 rate up (5m avg) to 2.4% — paging oncall.
Anna K: oncall here, looking now. where's customer impact?
Jordan M: seeing ~20 requests/sec hitting fallback and a handful of 429s for some long-context requests. acme-corp reported latency/timeouts in support chat.
Priya R: pulling the dashboard: queue_depth for inference-pool up to 820 in the last 5m (baseline ~120). tokens/sec p95 jumped ~3x.
Devon S: logs show sustained KV cache misses and slow kernel fallback on a small subset of requests (long seq). possible model variant hit.
Anna K: ok, live mitigation: 1) enable burst capacity (scale +2 nodes) 2) add temporary routing rule to route acme-corp traffic to dedicated pool 3) bump autoscaler cooldown to avoid flapping. doing step 1 now.
Maria L: I pushed a manual scale up to +2 nodes in us-west-2, should be available in ~90s. monitoring.
Jordan M: adding a short-term rate-limit for very long sequences from public API to reduce tokens/sec (soft limit) — will do 30s window.
oncall-bot: ACTION: manual_scale(started) by Maria L at 1768888891
Anna K: after scale, queue_depth dropped to ~260. 429s reduced to 0.6%.
Nate P: thumbs. this looks like capacity saturation rather than a code bug. main signal: sustained queue_depth + throttle_events. we should tune alerts to reflect sustained saturation vs transient blips.
Priya R: Agreed. current alerts are too chatty. Proposed alert changes (quick draft):
- queue_depth_high: trigger only if queue_depth > 600 for 3/5m (instead of current >400 instant).
- throttle_rate_p95: use p95(tokens/sec) > 1500 for 2m to page.
- throttle_event_burst: leave a low-severity alert for spikes (no page).
Jordan M: also add a composite alert: page only when (queue_depth sustained AND throttle_events rate > X) OR (customer 429s > 1%). reduces noise for low-impact capacity events.
Anna K: Can we express the queue alert as a percentile so one noisy worker can't trigger it? e.g., `max by(pool)(max_over_time(queue_depth[5m]))` -> but maybe use p95 across pools.
Priya R: here's a quick PromQL we can use for sustained queue depth:```
sum(max_over_time(queue_depth{env="prod",pool="inference"}[5m]) > 600) > 0
```This will detect sustained >600 across any shard.
Devon S: and for throttle events:```
sum(rate(throttle_events_total{env="prod"}[1m])) by (pool) > 10
```we can require this for 2 consecutive minutes.
Maria L: operational tweaks: add 5m alert debounce, escalate to page only if condition persists for >=3 minutes. add a non-paging slack alert for 1m transient spikes.
Anna K: runbook updates: add step to route high-priority customers to dedicated pool + how to increase burst capacity quickly. I'll update: https://go/runbooks/autoscale-throttle (draft).
Nate P: also add dashboard panels: tokens/sec heatmap (by customer), queue_depth per shard, throttle_events per model-variant, and a 10m moving window for 429 rate. makes RCA faster.
Jordan M: I'm assigning a follow-up ticket to product infra to add model-variant routing fallback (if variant A overloaded, route to variant B with slightly higher latency but fewer cache misses).
Anna K: quick post-incident checklist:
- [x] Mitigated immediate impact (scale + route)
- [ ] Update alerts to proposed thresholds (Priya / Maria)
- [ ] Create dashboard panels (Nate)
- [ ] Update runbook and paging policy (Anna)
- [ ] Postmortem writeup + customer outreach (Jordan)
Priya R: I'll open a PR for the alert changes and include test rules/explainers. Recommend we add a note: "avoid paging for <2m sustained unless 429 customer-facing >1%".
Devon S: minor note: autoscaler cooldown increase will help, but we should also cap autoscale burst to avoid OOMs on hosts. add a safety check in the autoscaler config.
Maria L: created alert PR: https://git.internal/alerts/1234 (draft). linking runbook draft in description.
oncall-bot: REMINDER: handoff scheduled in 25m. Anna K is current oncall.
Anna K: handing to Jordan for postmortem and customer comms — Jordan, you good to drive?
Jordan M: can do. I'll collect metrics, push postmortem, and coordinate an update to the Acme SRE contact.
Nate P: short term action item: change paging criteria so infra paging only occurs for composite condition. I'll make that change after review.
Anna K: thanks all — closing live triage. please follow up in the postmortem thread with timelines and root cause. felt like a classic capacity saturation + long-seq cache miss interaction.
Jordan M: logging final notes and will create the postmortem card. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
_meta: generated for dataset: production incidents - alert tuning + autoscale capacity
